notes.title: Update: Boss Fixes & More
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've got a larger update to address some of the issues in the game.

[h3][b]Anita:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the values of certain modules.
[*] Adjusted the "Injury Plague" module, adding a cooldown for Infect application and reducing the energy gain reduction.
[*] Fixed an issue where the status of some modules was not correctly displayed on the HUD.
[*] Fixed a bug where Charge Shoot would apply more infections than the maximum allowed to bosses, causing some infections to not trigger.
[/list]
[h3][b]Commander:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the health of all Drones to decrease the time players spend dealing with them (Commander’s health has been increased to balance the difficulty).
[*] Drones now immediately attack for the player after being hacked, rather than waiting for the right moment. Hacked drones now only require one shot to hack.
[/list]
[h3][b]Molter:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Molter would instantly generate spikes during Armor Repair.
[*] Fixed a bug where scene masks would block danger warning icons.
[/list]
[h3][b]Reaper:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Reaper's Level Achievement displayed an incorrect number of required tasks.
[*] 
[/list]
[h3][b]Hunter:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunter’s arc-based abilities will no longer cast repeatedly during their effect period to reduce combat confusion. (For example, as long as BombArrow/Trap is still "Falling" to the field, no additional BombArrow/Trap abilities will be cast.)
[*] Increased the self-destruct speed of Hunter’s traps and enlarged their hitbox to make them easier to clear.
[*] Fixed an issue where Hunter’s arrows would flip direction, preventing attacks outside the warning range.
[/list]
[h3][b]Kurozan:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Kurozan would get stuck after being hit by Charge Shoot.
[*] Adjusted some visual errors and behaviors for Kurozan.
[/list]
[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the time management logic to prevent scenarios where the game would speed up abnormally.
[*] Adjusted certain visual effects.
[*] Updated the tutorial for Charge Attack.
[/list]

Thank you,
PQube & 18Light

[*] Adjusted the input conditions for charged attacks to make them easier to trigger and no longer get stuck in other states, while also making the effects more noticeable.

[*] Fixed an issue where Kurozan's split shuriken could not be eliminate by the Pulse Slicer, and some errors related to shuriken throwing direction.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage range of Commander’s Drone Laser sometimes did not match the warning area.
[*] Adjusted some player visual effects to make them more prominent on the battlefield.
[*] Fixed various issues with boss's grabbing abilities.
[*] Fixed execute's inconsistent key prompts.
[*] Fixed some triggering conditions for Molter's Level Achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where button icons displayed incorrectly when using the Nintendo Switch joystick.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you to everyone who played the NanoApostle Demo![/h2]

We're excited to say that today marks the official release day of NanoApostle. As we are a small team, we have made the decision to close down the demo version of the game to focus our attention on the full release.

The feedback gathered during this period has been instrumental in making NanoApostle the best it can be. As a result, we have been able to adress the following issues:

[list]
[*] Display Commander’s shield respawn countdown
[*] Fixed an issue where Commander would stop performing actions during certain action
[*] Fixed an issue where Commander would stop performing actions after entering Phase 2
[*] Fixed potential performance errors for Berserker when entering Phase 2
[*] Fixed a possible issue with the grappling hook direction when the player shoots it at bosses
[*] Extensive balancing and experience optimizations
[*] Optimized boss behavior trees
[*] Added Steam leaderboard functionality
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the full release of NanoApostle, available now!
